Name: The Unhinged Mayo Expansion
Author: jayjaydub
Description:
Have you ever wanted your farmer to drink mayo? Not only have I never wanted to, I'm allergic to it. But for the subset of players that have wanted to drink mayo, there's two mods that let you! 
This mod directly modifies mayo, duck mayo and dino mayo to be drinkable (out of a mug), and includes some dialogue for vanilla npcs, and two events.

Go download [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10281]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10281[/url] , it's a visually better mod that should be compatible with this mod. 

[size=4][b]Other Mayo Content Universe Mods (the other MCU)[/b][/size]
Unhinged Mayo Jar by SpaceChase [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17139]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17139
[/url]The Mayo House for Alternative Textures by the French Dodo. ﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17146]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17146
[/url]Pet Mayonaise Jar by the French Dodo [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17147]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17147[/url]
﻿And more mods to come! Are you not on the [url=http://https://discord.gg/krobus]Krobus[/url] Mod Makers discord and would like to join in on the list? You could either join in on the fun, or DM me!)


[b]How to See Content[/b]
To launch the first event, bring mayo onto your farm any time, any day. 
To launch the second event, after triggering the first visit Harvey while he's in the clinic. 
To launch the third event, go to the saloon after seeing the first event between noon and 4pm. 
﻿Idea and credit for this event to a friend at Grapefruit Skies who choses to remain enonymous.

All dialogue is dependent on seeing above events.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
This mod has only been tested for compatibility with SVE (and will have no conflicts with RSV, ES, DTZ, etc). If you do run into any issues let me know and I'll see what I can do. 

[b]Future Plans
[/b]More dialogue!
Minor first event issue. This requires either C# or 1.6 to implement, so I will be waiting for 1.6. This does not impact gameplay. Details below.
[spoiler]The mug to drink mayo from is stated to go into the player wallet, as a handwavey explanation of how the mayo turns into a mug. [/spoiler]
Mayo related drinks.
A Gus mini story-arc as he comes to accept the new mayo trend.


[b]Credits
[/b]I highly doubt this is what they anticipated when they helped me learn to mod, but many thanks to the Krobus Discord community. In particular Atravita, Spacechase/KittyCatCasey, Lemurkat and FlashShifter for patiently answering all my ridiculous questions. 

This mod was directly inspired by conversations at the Grapefruit Skies discord server, and any references to Jay is not to me but to a player's farmer who shares a similar name to me.
